bug.title: The scheduled rebalance service fails every slot: systemd provides neither the 1Password service token nor uv on PATH
bug.symptoms: The service's ExecStart (`%h/projects/nullius/run.sh vst-rebalance --book …`) was run with a systemd user unit's environment (HOME, USER, PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin): - with no OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, op run fails with "No accounts configured for use with 1Password CLI."; - with the token supplied, it fails with `[ERROR] error while starting process: exec: "uv": executable file not found in $PATH`. uv lives in ~/.local/bin/uv. In an interactive shell both work, because ~/.zshrc exports OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN from ~/.config/op/service-token (mode 0600) and puts ~/.local/bin on PATH. A systemd user service runs neither.
bug.reproduction_steps: From the repository root: `env -i HOME=$HOME USER=$USER PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin ./run.sh vst --help` fails on op. Adding OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN="$(cat ~/.config/op/service-token)" then fails on uv.
bug.expected: The service supplies both itself: - Environment=PATH puts %h/.local/bin before /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin. - ExecStart loads OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN at start from %h/.config/op/service-token, for example /bin/sh -c 'OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN="$(cat %h/.config/op/service-token)" exec %h/projects/nullius/run.sh vst-rebalance --book …'. The token value never appears in the unit file, the repository or any log line. - A missing or unreadable token file makes the unit fail with a clear message, not start op without credentials. Tests parse the unit and pin the PATH entry, the token-file load and the absence of any literal token. A test also runs the ExecStart command string in an env -i environment, with run.sh replaced by a stub, to prove PATH and the token reach the child.
bug.actual: Root cause: the unit assumes the interactive shell's environment. It sets neither PATH nor the 1Password service-account token, both of which run.sh needs (op run, then uv run).
bug.constraints: Never write a token, key or secret into any repository file, test or log Nothing installs or enables the units No network access in any test
